latest_repair.issue: Readiness repeatedly returned HTTP 503 after a normal backend restart.
latest_repair.observed: GET /health/live returned 200; GET /health/ready returned 503 with socket error -3: Temporary failure in name resolution.
latest_repair.root_cause: The system cannot resolve the configured Neon hostname. The previous PGHOSTADDR workaround was tied to one launcher invocation and absent after normal restarts.
changes: Added opt-in NEON_DNS_FALLBACK configuration shared by API, scheduler worker and Alembic.
Saved NEON_DNS_FALLBACK=true in existing local environment files; all other parsed settings were preserved.
System resolution runs first on new physical connections; DNS failures can use HTTPS public DNS, with TTL-limited hostname-only caching and refreshed hostaddr.
Original Neon hostname, credentials and TLS settings are retained; authentication/database/TLS errors are not retried as DNS errors.
Launcher and isolated runner enable the shared fallback rather than permanently pinning one PGHOSTADDR value.
Moved readiness work to FastAPI's thread pool so slow DNS/database checks cannot block liveness.
verification: 13 focused DNS/readiness tests passed before the complete 100-test unit run.
Real application connection and required schema passed a read-only check without PGHOSTADDR.
Backend restarted with the documented normal launcher command and no --resolve-neon-dns flag.
Three consecutive GET /health/ready requests returned HTTP 200 and connected.
Actual isolated Neon reconnection under forced DNS failures and the two-user database workflow passed.
Final source checks and service watcher results are in qa_tests/results/latest.json.
latest_repair.configuration_scope: Process-local project option. No system DNS files, database credentials or application rows were changed.

current_pass.scope: Startup supervision, durable search/analysis/draft jobs, responsiveness, job catalog/index recovery, session/polling recovery and browser-account isolation.
repairs: Added scripts/run_local.py: starts UI/API, waits for readiness, runs a watcher, restarts only owned child processes with a bounded crash budget.
Persisted four supported background operations with row-locked claims, renewable leases, at most three interruption attempts, fenced results and idempotent child-search IDs.
Moved 32 blocking database routes onto FastAPI worker threads.
Bound dead TCP waits and runtime SQL statements. Corrected the Neon pooler restriction by applying SET LOCAL per transaction rather than startup options.
Rebuilt missing Chroma job vectors from canonical Neon records without changing source verification dates.
Applied criteria before the 200-result SQL limit; escaped literal keyword wildcards; normalized city aliases; made new search defaults seven days.
Bound match-cache memory and lifetime, rejected stale writes after invalidation, and surfaced vector-service errors as failures.
Saved opaque task IDs with public listing context for page reload recovery; retried transient status outages without overlapping polls.
Distinguished session-restoration outages from invalid credentials and added an explicit connection retry.
Made diagnostics reachable after analysis; constrained AI-reported present skills and score bounds; bound private route-history results to the original account.
Preserved the added manual Ollama probe under qa_tests/manual/check_ollama_tags.py.
